description:
Soo-ha Yoon's last hope, his virtual career, has failed. As he wonders how to make a living, he receives a call from his close friend, Hee-su. At his request, Soo-ha reluctantly goes to work as a temporary assistant staff. However, the main model, Ji-hoon Seo, fails to show up on a whim, leaving the photoshoot in a lurch. The frantic photographer spots Soo-ha and, in a moment of desperation, asks him to step in as a replacement model. As time passes and Soo-ha starts to about the incident, the photo book he shot becomes a hot topic, gradually gaining public attention. How will Soo-ha react and make a decision when he hears this news?

[Official English](https://comics.inkr.com/title/4671-play)
